spreads.title: Four Friends by the Banyan Tree

game.start: Evening has come to the banyan glade! Tap the four glowing fireflies to light the circle for Sasa.
game.praise: Warm golden light! All four friends are ready for Full Moon Giving Day!

game.start: Help Sasa's friends pack their forest gifts! Tap the lotus roots, red berries, and golden mangoes, then tap each friend.
game.praise: Crisp roots, sweet berries, and ripe mangoes, all ready to share!

spreads.title: A Wish That Warmed the Sky

game.start: Sasa's kind wish rises to the sky! Tap the three golden sunbeams to warm King Sakka's cloud seat.
game.praise: Golden light! King Sakka felt Sasa's brave wish all the way above the clouds!

game.start: Three kind friends offer their food! Tap Otter's roots, Jackal's berries, and Monkey's mangoes in order.
game.praise: Three generous offers! Now the old traveller walks straight to little Sasa.

game.start: The traveller asks for a warm fire! Tap the three bundles of dry wood to kindle the golden light.
game.praise: Whoosh! Bright golden flames rise up beside the banyan tree!

spreads.title: The Fire That Did Not Burn

game.start: Sasa leaps into the test-fire! Tap the four golden flames to bloom them into cool white lotus flowers!
game.praise: Hush, shimmer! Cool white lotus petals cradle little Sasa, safe and unharmed!

game.start: The patched cloak falls away! Tap the three starlight rays around King Sakka to shine across the hill.
game.praise: Ting-a-ling! King Sakka shines in gold and starlight beside little Sasa!

spreads.title: Painting the Hare on the Moon

game.start: Help King Sakka paint Sasa on the full moon! Tap the five shining star-dots in order across the moon.
game.praise: Swish, sweep! Look up: the silver Hare shines bright upon the full moon!

spreads.title: A Feast Under the Hare Moon

game.start: Grandmother and Meera are hungry! Tap the lotus roots, red berries, and golden mangoes to share the feast.
game.praise: Yum! Every morning gift fed a hungry guest under the bright Hare Moon!

game.start: Float warm lights on the lotus river! Tap the five clay lamps so they glow beneath the Hare Moon.
game.praise: Every clay lamp shines on the water, glowing right back at gentle Sasa!
